1

Convert to a Professional Account & Link a Facebook Page

Meta's Graph API does not allow publishing from personal Instagram accounts. Your profile must be a Professional (Business or Creator) account linked to a Facebook Page you manage.

  1. Open Instagram on your phone → go to Settings and activity → Account type and tools → tap Switch to professional account (choose either Creator or Business).
  2. If you do not already have a Facebook Page, create one at facebook.com/pages/create.
  3. Link your Instagram to your Facebook Page via Meta Business Suite → Instagram Accounts, or inside Instagram mobile app under Edit profile → Page → Connect or create.
2

Create a Meta Developer App

You need a Meta App container to generate API access tokens and obtain your App ID and App Secret.

  1. Sign in with your Facebook account at the Meta for Developers App Dashboard and click Create App.
  2. Enter an App Name (e.g., Fivestar Reels Publisher) and your contact email.
  3. When asked for use case or app type:
    • Select Other → click Next → select Business as the app type → click Create app.
    • (If using the newer Meta dashboard layout, select "Publish to Instagram" or "Instagram Graph API").
  4. Once inside your App Dashboard, go to App settings → Basic in the left sidebar.
  5. Copy your App ID, and click Show to copy your App Secret.
No Meta App Review or Verification Needed for Personal Use!
By default, your app is in Development Mode. As the app creator, your Facebook account is automatically an Administrator and Developer. This means you can immediately publish Reels to your own connected Instagram account without going through Meta's business verification or app review!
3

Generate Your Graph API Access Token (EAA...)

Use Meta's Graph API Explorer to generate your User Access Token authorized for Reels publishing.

  1. Open the Meta Graph API Explorer.
  2. In the top right panel under Meta App, select the app you just created in Step 2.
  3. Under User or Page, select User Token.
  4. Under Permissions, click Add a Permission and select all 5 permissions below:
instagram_basic
instagram_content_publish
pages_show_list
pages_read_engagement
business_management
  1. Click Generate Access Token. In the Facebook login popup, check the boxes to grant access to both your Facebook Page and linked Instagram account.
  2. Copy the generated token string starting with EAA... from the top Access Token field.
Extending Token to 60 Days:
Tokens generated in the Graph API Explorer expire after 1 hour. You can extend it in two easy ways:
  • Option A (Recommended): Enter your Meta App ID and Meta App Secret in Fivestar Settings along with the token. Fivestar will automatically extend and refresh your token for 60 days.
  • Option B: Paste the token into the Meta Access Token Debugger, click Debug, and click Extend Access Token at the bottom.
4

Fill In Fivestar Settings (⚙️)

Click the Settings (⚙️) button in the top right of Fivestar and paste your credentials into the Instagram section:

Setting Field Status Where to Get Value
Meta Graph API Access Token Required The EAA... token string copied from Step 3 (Graph API Explorer).
Instagram Business/Creator User ID Optional (Auto-detected) Leave blank to automatically detect your Instagram account from your linked Facebook Page. If you prefer to enter it manually, query me/accounts?fields=instagram_business_account in Graph API Explorer to find the 17-digit numeric ID.
Meta App ID Recommended Found in Meta Developer Dashboard → App settings → Basic. Allows Fivestar to renew your token for 60 days.
Meta App Secret Recommended Found next to App ID in App settings → Basic (click Show). Used with App ID to exchange short-lived tokens for 60-day tokens.

Click Save & Connect Instagram. Fivestar will verify the token, fetch your Instagram username, and display your connected account!

5

How Fivestar Uploads Reels & Troubleshooting

  • No Cloud Hosting or S3 Required: Fivestar uploads your exported MP4 directly from your computer to Meta's servers using the Resumable Binary Upload endpoint (rupload.facebook.com). You do not need any public web domain or external file hosting.
  • Video Format Requirements: Vertical MP4 (9:16 aspect ratio, recommended 1080x1920), 30 to 60 fps, duration between 3 seconds and 90 seconds (Fivestar clips are 30–60s by default, which fits Instagram Reels guidelines).
  • "No Instagram Business account found": Make sure your Instagram account was converted to Business or Creator and connected to a Facebook Page, and that you gave permissions to that Facebook Page during the popup in Step 3.
  • "Session Expired" / "Error validating access token": Your 1-hour token expired. Enter your Meta App ID and Meta App Secret in Settings and click Extend Token (or re-generate an extended token via Token Debugger).
  • "Requires instagram_content_publish": Make sure all 5 permissions listed in Step 3 were added before clicking Generate Access Token.
